title: fix(cli): a connection label printed by the CLI removes a password wherever the URL rules read one
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:CLI 打印的数据库连接标签(`os dev` / `os start` / `os serve` 启动横幅与迁移确认)改为通过 spec 的共享 URL 规则函数 `redactUrlPassword` 去掉密码,不再自带一套规则。
- 为什么改:凡是平台 URL 规则读出密码的值,终端标签都必须去掉它;标签与数据源读写门共用同一套规则,规则扩展时标签自动跟随。
- 风险与回滚:仅影响打印文本;共享规则读不出密码的值输出逐字节不变(已用对照用例钉住)。回滚即还原单个函数。
- 先看:`packages/cli/src/utils/connection-display.ts` 的 `redactConnectionUrl` 前两行;`connection-display.test.ts` 新增的 describe 块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/connection-display.test.ts`,预期 27 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `redactConnectionUrl` (the database label the CLI prints) removes the password first through `redactUrlPassword` from `@objectstack/spec/data`, the shared userinfo function the datasource read path uses. Rule: a connection label printed by the CLI removes a password wherever the URL rules read one.
- No second grammar lives in the CLI. The existing display shaping (username and query string dropped through the URL parser, or the userinfo segment dropped by hand when the parser rejects the value) runs unchanged after that step.
- `@objectstack/cli` already depends on `@objectstack/spec` (`dependencies`, `workspace:*`), so no dependency is added.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/cli` patch.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the existing harness file `packages/cli/src/utils/connection-display.test.ts`, named for the rule:

- the password is removed wherever the shared grammar reads one;
- the whole password is removed up to the boundary the shared grammar draws;
- a property pin: across a corpus of URL shapes, the label never contains a password that `urlUserinfoPassword` (the shared grammar's own accessor) reads, with a non-vacuity floor of 8 shapes;
- controls, byte for byte against today's output: `postgres://`, `libsql://`, `file:` (both spellings), `sqlite:`, no userinfo, username-only userinfo, an empty password, a multi-host value, `:memory:`, `(in-memory)`, and values the URL parser already cleaned.

Expected outputs for the controls were computed from the pre-change function before they were written into the pins.

## Acceptance notes

- One-shot ablation (not kept as a file): replacing the shared-grammar step with the identity turns the three rule pins red (3 failed, 24 passed) while every control stays green; restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The label follows any future widening of the shared grammar with no edit here; the property pin then covers the new shapes through the oracle.

## Verification

- `connection-display.test.ts`: 27/27 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- Derived gate families (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`): 59 commands run locally; 54 exit 0. Five answered `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`, `check:type-check-debt`) because they need a whole-repo build. They are NOT MEASURED locally and are left to `Lint & Repo Gates` in CI.
